description: MIA, 2005 June regular phase: 55 of 55 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 55 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 55 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20240810141324: 55 listed, 55 matched to MLB's picks by name (5 by surname in the same round: #276 MLB "James Brauer" / "Jim Brauer"; #396 MLB "Jeffrey Van Houten" / "Jeff Van Houten"; #486 MLB "Jonathan Lewis" / "Jon Lewis"; #906 MLB "Christopher Haupt" / "Chris Haupt"; #1056 MLB "Jacob Taylor" / "Jake Taylor")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
